answer: An admission auction blocks bulk identity farming. Applicants bid POA for one of 40 slots; the atlas of bids is public. Winning bids are burned, and the anchor price is the 40th bid, 800 POA. A saffron flag marks bidders linked to three or more applicants, and flagged bids are excluded. Faking 100 identities burns 80,000 POA against 2,000 earned per seat, so the attack loses 78,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and holds its slot 20 epochs.
